s: Din sukka sheula ugezula ubo y"b seipim: mi shello asa sukka qodem hechag, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — hare zeh oseh sukka bechullo shel moed veyosheb bah. Veap al pi shenneemar "chag hassukkot taaseh leka shibat yamim", en kavvanat hakkatub laasot sukka hareuya leshiba yamim perat lechullo shel moed sheenah reuya leshiba yamim, ella kavvanat hakkatub kol shibat hayyamim taaseh sukka, im lo asita beyom rishon — taaseh beyom sheni, vaapillu besop yom hashshebii:
Veken muttar latzet missukka zo velesheb besukka acheret, veen tzarik lesheb kol shibat hayyamim besukka achat:

Ap al pi sheomra tora "chag hassukkot taaseh leka", "leka" — "mishshelleka", kelomar shettehe hassukka shelleka velo shel chabereka — ap al pi ken yotze adam yede chobato besukka sheula, dekevan shenniknas lah birshut — hare hi keshello, velo neemar "leka mishshelleka", ella lehotzi et haggezula veal derek sheyyitbaer. Veken yotze adam yede chobato besukka sheyyesh lo shuttaput bah im chabero, apillu im niknas lah shello birshut chabero, veen zeh niqra gazel, kevan sheal daat ken nishtattepu shekkol echad mehem yishtammesh bah kirtzono:

Vaapillu sukka haggezula — peamim shehi keshera. Ketzad? Hare shettiqqen yisrael sukkato uba chabero vehotzio missukkato ugezalah veyashab bah — yatza, sheen haqqarqa nigzelet, kelomar sheen aleha torat gazel kemittaltelin laamod bechezqat haggazlan ubirshuto lekol dabar, kegon sheim hishbicha birshut haggazlan — en hashshebach shello kemo bemittaltelin, ella leolam hi bechezqat bealeha, vahare hi kishula beyad haggazlan, vekol hamchubbar laqqarqa — hare hu keqarqa, sheeno niqneh lehaggazlan ella hare hu keshaul beyado, ulepikak sukka zo shehi benuya al haqqarqa — hare hi kishula beyad haggazlan, veyotze hu bah yede chobato kemo sheyyotzein besukka sheula:

Veim gazal etzim vesikkek bahem sukkato, ap al pi shello chibberan lesukkato ella hinnichan al gabbe sukkato, velo asa bahen shum shinnuy beinyan shebbishar yemot hashshana chayyab lehachazir haetzim atzman lehannigzal, shehare lo qana otam kelal kevan shello asa bahem shum shinnuy, mikkol maqom mishshum mitzvat sukka tiqqenu chakamim sheen lehannigzal ella deme haetzim bilbad, veeno tzarik listor sukkato kede lehachazir lo haetzim atzman, umuttar lesheb besukka zo vaapillu lekattechilla. Veim en haggazlan rotzeh latet lo deme haetzim — eno yotze yede chobato besukka zo, shehare gezula hi beyado:

Veken im gazal sukka sheenah mechubberet laqqarqa, kegon sheasuya berosh haagala o berosh hassepina, shehare hi kemittaltelin veyesh aleha torat gazel lihyot omedet bechezqat haggazlan lekol dabar, veenah kishula beyado ella hare hi gezula tachat yado, ulepikak im yashab bah bechag — lo yatza yede chobato. Vaapillu im rotzeh latet lehannigzal deme sukkato — en moil lo kelum, shello tiqqenu chakamim ken ella im ken tarach aleha libnotah leshem mitzva, kegon sheggazal etzim vesikkek bahen, abal zeh sheggazal sukka keshera velo tarach aleha velo hotzi aleha hotzaot lehakshirah — tzarik lehachazirah beeneha lebalah:

Veken im reuben bana sukka beqarqaito shel shimon shello middato veshimon taqap al reuben vehotzio missukkato habbenuya baqqarqa shello veyashab bah — lo yatza yede chobato, shehare gezula hi tachat yado, veenah kishula, kevan sheenah omedet al qarqa shel reuben. Veap al pi shekkol hamchubbar laqqarqa hare hu keqarqa, veqarqa en aleha torat gezela ella torat sheela, mikkol maqom kevan sheen hassukka omedet al qarqa shel nigzal ella al qarqa shel haggazlan — hare hi bechezqato shel haggazlan lekol dabar, kemo shear mittaltelin, shekkevan shenniknas lirshut haggazlan — hare hi bechezqato lekol dabar veenah kishula beyado, ella hare hen gezulin tachat yado:

Abal im reuben bana sukkato beqarqao shel shimon middato, shehishil lo haqqarqa leshibat yeme hechag veachar kak gazal mimmennu sukkato veyashab bah — yatza yede chobato, shekkol shibat yeme hechag haqqarqa shel reuben vesukkato omedet bechezqato ap leachar sheggezalah shimon mimmennu, shekkol hamchubbar laqqarqa — hare hu keqarqa, sheen aleha torat gezela ella torat sheela kemo shennitbaer:

Vekol zeh bediabad shekkebar yashab bah — yatza yede chobato, abal lekattechilla en lesheb besukkato shel chabero shello middato, ap al pi sheen dato legozlah mimmennu, shemma baal hassukka hu maqpid al zeh shello yireh chabero et akilato veet asaqayv beli yediato. Abal muttar likkanes ulesheb besukkat chabero beshaa sheen baal hassukka sham besukkato, shebbevadday lo yaqpid al zeh, shennoach lo leadam shetteaseh mitzva bemamono bedabar sheen bo chesron kis kemo shennitbaer besiman y"d:

Veken en laasot sukka lekattechilla beqarqa shel chabero shello middato, deshemma baal haqqarqa hu maqpid al shehu qobea dirato birshuto beli yediato, veen omerim noach lo leadam sheyyaasu mitzva bemamono ella kesheosin beaqray bealma, abal lo keshemmishtammesh bemamono biqbiut kemo shennitbaer besiman y"d:

Veken en laasot sukka lekattechilla beqarqa shel rabbim, kegon birchob hair vekayyotze bo bemaqom sheharabbim oberim sham, vaapillu im kol hair hi shel yisrael vehayyisrael hu bevadday mochel lo al kak, mikkol maqom en laasot sukka birshut harabbim, shehare yesh lekol haolam hilluk bo kemo shekkatub bechoshen mishpat siman [q]s"b, vehaggoyim enan mochalin al kak, vahare hi sukka gezula. Veap al pi shebbediabad yotze besukka gezula haomedet beqarqa [hannigzal] kemo shennitbaer, mikkol maqom lekattechilla en lesheb besukka haomedet beqarqa shel chabero, mippene sheenah niqret shello mammash, vehattora omra "taaseh leka" — "mishshelleka", veenah doma lishela mammash shehishilah lo middato vahare hi keshello mammash, ulekak yesh limchot behaosim sukka birshut harabbim. Vekol maqom shebbearnu sheen laasot sham sukka lekattechilla, veabar veasa, ap al pi shehi keshera kemo shennitbaer, mikkol maqom en lebarek aleha, kevan sheal yede abera baa sukka zo leyado — en zeh mebarek ella menaetz:

Lo yeqatztzetz hayyisrael beatzmo et hassekak miyyaar shel goy apillu middaat haggoy, ella yeqatztzetzennu haggoy veyittenennu leyad hayyisrael, o yeqatztzetzennu yisrael acher shello yihyeh yosheb besukka zo sheyyaasu missekak zeh veyittenennu leyisrael baal hassukka, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman trm"t, ayyen sham, vesham yitbaer kol perate din zeh:
